_comment: Grow's Hadith world: one key line per hadith of an-Nawawi's Forty, Arabic and English, each quoted exactly from the source text (scripts/build_nawawi40.py checks; tests/test_nawawi40.py holds it). No word here is the app's own.

1: إنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
Actions are (judged) by motives (niyyah), so each man will have what he intended.
2: أَنْ تَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّك تَرَاهُ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَرَاهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَرَاك
It is that you should serve Allah as though you could see Him, for though you cannot see Him yet He sees you.
3: Islam has been built on five [pillars]
4: إنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ يُجْمَعُ خَلْقُهُ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا
Verily the creation of each one of you is brought together in his mother’s womb for forty days
5: مَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِي أَمْرِنَا هَذَا مَا لَيْسَ مِنْهُ فَهُوَ رَدٌّ
He who innovates something in this matter of ours (i.e., Islam) that is not of it will have it rejected (by Allah).
6: إنَّ الْحَلَالَ بَيِّنٌ، وَإِنَّ الْحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌ
That which is lawful is clear and that which is unlawful is clear
8: أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ
I have been ordered to fight against the people until they testify that there is none worthy of worship except Allah
9: مَا نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْهُ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ، وَمَا أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِهِ فَأْتُوا مِنْهُ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ
What I have forbidden for you, avoid. What I have ordered you [to do], do as much of it as you can.
10: إنَّ اللَّهَ طَيِّبٌ لَا يَقْبَلُ إلَّا طَيِّبًا
Allah the Almighty is Good and accepts only that which is good.
11: دَعْ مَا يُرِيبُك إلَى مَا لَا يُرِيبُك
Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt.
12: مِنْ حُسْنِ إسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ
Part of the perfection of one’s Islam is his leaving that which does not concern him.
13: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
None of you [truly] believes until he loves for his brother that which he loves for himself.
14: It is not permissible to spill the blood of a Muslim except in three [instances]
15: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاَللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
Let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day speak good, or keep silent
17: إنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الْإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
Verily Allah has prescribed ihsan (proficiency, perfection) in all things.
18: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْت، وَأَتْبِعْ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقْ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
Have taqwa (fear) of Allah wherever you may be, and follow up a bad deed with a good deed which will wipe it out, and behave well towards the people.
19: احْفَظْ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْك، احْفَظْ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَك
Be mindful of Allah and Allah will protect you. Be mindful of Allah and you will find Him in front of you.
20: إذَا لَمْ تَسْتَحِ فَاصْنَعْ مَا شِئْت
If you feel no shame, then do as you wish.
21: Say I believe in Allah — and then be steadfast.
22: treat as lawful that which is halal, and treat as forbidden that which is haram
24: I have forbidden dhulm (oppression) for Myself
25: إنَّ بِكُلِّ تَسْبِيحَةٍ صَدَقَةً، وَكُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ صَدَقَةً
Truly every tasbeehah [saying: 'subhan-Allah'] is a charity, and every takbeerah [saying: 'Allahu akbar'] is a charity
26: كُلُّ سُلَامَى مِنْ النَّاسِ عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ
Every joint of a person must perform a charity each day that the sun rises
28: I counsel you to have taqwa (fear) of Allah, and to listen and obey [your leader]
30: إنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى فَرَضَ فَرَائِضَ فَلَا تُضَيِّعُوهَا
Verily Allah ta’ala has laid down religious obligations (fara’id), so do not neglect them
31: ازْهَدْ فِي الدُّنْيَا يُحِبَّك اللهُ، وَازْهَدْ فِيمَا عِنْدَ النَّاسِ يُحِبَّك النَّاسُ
Renounce the world and Allah will love you, and renounce what the people possess and the people will love you.
32: There should be neither harming (darar) nor reciprocating harm (dirar).
33: الْبَيِّنَةَ عَلَى الْمُدَّعِي، وَالْيَمِينَ عَلَى مَنْ أَنْكَرَ
the onus of proof is upon the claimant, and the taking of an oath is upon him who denies.
34: مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمْ مُنْكَرًا فَلْيُغَيِّرْهُ بِيَدِهِ
Whosoever of you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand
35: A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim
36: مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
Whoever removes a worldly grief from a believer, Allah will remove from him one of the griefs of the Day of Resurrection.
37: Verily Allah ta’ala has written down the good deeds and the evil deeds
38: مَنْ عَادَى لِي وَلِيًّا فَقْد آذَنْتهُ بِالْحَرْبِ
Whosoever shows enmity to a wali (friend) of Mine, then I have declared war against him.
39: إنَّ اللَّهَ تَجَاوَزَ لِي عَنْ أُمَّتِي الْخَطَأَ وَالنِّسْيَانَ وَمَا اسْتُكْرِهُوا عَلَيْهِ
Verily Allah has pardoned [or been lenient with] for me my ummah: their mistakes, their forgetfulness, and that which they have been forced to do under duress.
40: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّك غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ
Be in this world as though you were a stranger or a wayfarer.
41: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يَكُونَ هَوَاهُ تَبَعًا لِمَا جِئْتُ بِهِ
None of you [truly] believes until his desires are subservient to that which I have brought.
42: يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ! إِنَّكَ مَا دَعَوْتنِي وَرَجَوْتنِي غَفَرْتُ لَك عَلَى مَا كَانَ مِنْك وَلَا أُبَالِي
O Son of Adam, as long as you invoke Me and ask of Me, I shall forgive you for what you have done, and I shall not mind.
